summary.text: Steve Yurash is the Colorado Center Party candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 52 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Yara Zokaie.
A retired computer engineer, he ran for the same seat in 2024 and for U.S. House Colorado District 2 in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Steve Yurash was born in Palo Alto, California, and received a bachelor's degree from San Jose State University in 1982; Ballotpedia lists his profession as computer engineer.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired computer chip engineer who had served on the Larimer County Board of Health and the City of Fort Collins Electric Board, and as State Chairman of the Colorado Center Party.
Yurash ran in the 2022 general election for U.S. House Colorado District 2, which incumbent Joe Neguse won.
In 2024 he ran in the general election for Colorado House of Representatives District 52, which Yara Zokaie won.
